data.name: Martguerita
data.gender_notes: Martguerita is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Italian name Marta, meaning 'Mary', and the suffix -gerita, meaning 'little shepherdess'. This name carries the significance of Mary's role as a shepherdess of souls and the protector of her flock in Christian tradition. The name Martguerita carries the meaning “Mary of Jasgur (Jasgur's Mary)” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Martguerita usually hope their child will grow to embody mary of jasgur (jasgur's mary) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine protection and nurturing love.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Martguerita total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Martguerita is an Italian-origin name that holds a rich cultural legacy. As mentioned, the name is derived from Marta, a name associated with Saint Martha, who is celebrated in Christian tradition. Saint Martha is known for her faith, hospitality, and her role as a shepherdess of souls. This name carries the cultural significance of strong Christian faith and Italian heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Martguerita holds a deep spiritual significance as it reflects the Namesake's (Saint Martha's) role as a shepherdess of souls. Mary, being the epitome of faith and protection in Christianity, is represented as a shepherdess, guiding and nurturing her flock just as Martha did. This name is a reminder of the spiritual responsibility we all have to care for our fellow beings and guide them on their spiritual journey.
